name: Luna
source:
Luna is a native of Firn, raised in Sythia, working in the Byrathes mansion as a maid. She strives for a better life, and a better future, and with your help, she may achieve such a life.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
